description: Solar Installations is a dataset listed in City of Cambridge open data portal (data.cambridgema.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Cambridge. This dataset identifies locations of known solar installations. It includes both photovoltaic (PV) and solar hot water installations. The location coordinates may not represent the exact placement of the solar equipment on each parcel, particularly for larger parcels or those with solar equipment in multiple locations. Coverage: Cambridge, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the category Energy and the Environment. Its tags are sustainability, community development department - cdd, energy, environment, solar. The table has 15 columns. Attribution on the portal: Cambridge Community Development Department. The portal shows 2026-08-20 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cambridgema-gov-portal.
